e.title: actuarcredibility (Python)
e.summary: 精算信度模型 Python 库（PyPI，MIT）：Bühlmann/Bühlmann-Straub/Jewell 层次/Hachemeister 回归/有限波动/贝叶斯 PyMC
e.body:
actuarcredibility 是精算信度模型的 Python 库（PyPI，MIT，beta）：覆盖 Bühlmann、Bühlmann-Straub、Jewell 层次模型、Hachemeister 回归、经典有限波动信度，以及基于 PyMC 的可选贝叶斯模型——输出与 pandas DataFrame 集成。参考文献：Bühlmann & Gisler (2005)、Klugman 第 20 章。对 RIAA：信度理论的 Python 侧完整实现（与 R 的 credibility 包互补）。与 [[credibility]]（信度条目）、[[insurance-credibility]]（burning-cost）、[[mg-credibility]]（CAS 专著）互补。关联 [[actuarial-pricing]]、[[insurance-thin-data]]。

e.summary_hk: 精算信度模型 Python 庫（PyPI，MIT）：Bühlmann/Bühlmann-Straub/Jewell 層次/Hachemeister 回歸/有限波動/貝葉斯 PyMC
e.body_en:
actuarcredibility is a Python library for actuarial credibility models (PyPI, MIT, beta): covering Bühlmann, Bühlmann-Straub, Jewell hierarchical, Hachemeister regression, classical limited-fluctuation, and an optional Bayesian model via PyMC — outputs integrate with pandas DataFrames. References Bühlmann & Gisler (2005) and Klugman ch. 20. For RIAA: the Python-side complete implementation of credibility theory (complementing the R credibility package). Complements [[credibility]] (credibility entry), [[insurance-credibility]] (burning-cost) and [[mg-credibility]] (CAS monograph). Related: [[actuarial-pricing]], [[insurance-thin-data]].

## Similar tools
